title: Umwizera atwikiriwe mu Rugo rw'Umunyagitugu
intro: Mu nzu z’inzahabu z’umutware w’ubwibone kuruta abandi bose bazwi na Korowani — aho ukurenga ku Bumana kwasobanura itegeko ryose — umutima umwe waragendagenda hagati y’abafise agateka, uhisha amabanga ateye akaga kuruta ayandi yose mu maso y’abantu. Uwo muntu yari afise ukwizera kwari kubujijwe cane muri izo nkike ku buryo iyo kuvumburwa kwobaye gutuma apfa ata gukeka. Yamara rero, ukwemera kwari kwaka nk’urubeya munsi y’ivu, maze igihe kigeze, ukuri kwaravuze n’ubutwari bwanyiganyije umushinge nyene w’ingoro y’uwo munyagitugu.
clues: Nabaye hagati y’abantu bo mu mugwi w’imbere w’umutware w’ububasha kandi w’ubwibone kuruta abandi bose bo mu gihe canje, nkikujwe n’ubutunzi n’ububasha.
Nanyegeje ivyo nemera vy’ukuri mu mutima wanje, ntinya ubuzima bwanje kubera abatwara n’ububisha n’agahahazo.
Igihe abantu banje bakekeranya kandi bagahungabana imbere y’ukuri, narateye intambwe kugira ndababurire ivy’agahomerabunwa vyari vyashikiye amahanga ya kera yanse intumwa z’Umukama wabo.
Naributse abantu banje inkuru y’umusore akundwa w’inzozi yajugunywe hasi n’incuti ziwe bwite ariko akaduga agira ubukuru bukomeye mu gihugu ca kure.
Nahimirije abantu banje kutumvira umutware yabazimiye, ahubwo ndabatumira ngo bankurikire mu nzira y’ubugororotsi n’uburongozi.
Naravuga ukuri ku mugaragaro naho abayoboke b’uwo munyagitugu batera ubwoba ko bazonyicisha amabuye canke bazonyirukana mu gihugu.
